visuals.advice: Add before/after pictures to the description, at phone size first: screenshots for looks, a GIF for motion. `npm run pr-gif -- <scenario.ts> --dir <PR number>` records main and this branch (a scenario like scripts/gif-scenarios/example.ts, moving with gif.glide, click, drag and scroll, with pauses), hosts the GIFs on the screenshots branch and prints the table to paste; it records in WebKit, which needs `npx playwright install --with-deps webkit` first. Or tick "No visible UI change" in the template. Editing the description re-runs this check.

readme-screenshots.source: the production build, every /api call and the dictionary stubbed (e2e/readme.shots.ts)

visual-baselines.command: npx playwright install --with-deps webkit && npx playwright test --project='visual-*' --update-snapshots

ciFixChecks: `npm run format:check` (`npm run format` rewrites what it flags)
`npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code src/gql/ && test -z "$(git status --porcelain src/gql/)"` (if an operation or the SDL changed, commit the regenerated `src/gql/` too)

`npm run db:generate` must print "No schema changes" (if api/_db/schema.ts changed, commit the new migration in `drizzle/` too; a rename makes drizzle-kit ask a question it can only take in a terminal)
`npx playwright install --with-deps webkit && npx playwright test --project=desktop --project=phone` (E2E's functional tests; its visual projects are in "can't run")
cannotRun: the answer-quality eval (it needs the Gemini key)

exempt.PR visuals: Wants pictures in the PR description, which no code change gives (autofix skips its failure too).

files: src/gql/**: generated by graphql-codegen from the schema
codegen.ts: graphql-codegen's config, not app code
src/setupTests.ts: Vitest's setup file, which Vitest never measures
e2e/fixtures.ts: Playwright support for the e2e suite, which unit coverage doesn't run
e2e/readme.shots.ts: Playwright support for the e2e suite, which unit coverage doesn't run
e2e/visual.ts: Playwright support for the e2e suite, which unit coverage doesn't run
